source_note: Form S-1/A Amendment No. 3, filed 2026-11-17: cover page, The Offering, Shares Eligible for Future Sale, Underwriting. It keeps the 70 to 78 range and the share counts of Amendment No. 2 and lowers the day-one employee release from 316 to 315 million shares. Dates, book coverage and the expected price are from press reports; the price report is the Wall Street Journal's of 2026-11-17 and is not final. The 1.2 multiple is SEC Rule 430A: a price that moves the deal size by no more than 20% needs no new range filing.
edgar_check_note: No registration amendment after Amendment No. 3. If a later S-1/A changes the range, update last_range and last_range_filed_on and rerun.
